description: Hurricane Helene Strategic Wildfire Rapid Risk Assessment is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Southern Fire Exchange; USDA, U.S. Department of Agriculture. This strategic wildfire rapid risk assessment seeks to identify areas where disturbance from Hurricane Helene may compound existing wildfire risks. The effort can inform post-hurricane fuels management priorities and wildfire response strategies. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Flooding – Rainfall-induced, High Winds, Landslides, Wildfire. Assets: Critical Facilities, Energy and Utilities, Forestry, Natural Areas and Wildlife, People, Property, Transportation and Mobility. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
